title: Loved Claw Eden, but now it won’t load
body: Started playing a few days ago. Won a few prizes. Tried to launch the app today and it won’t load. Hopefully I at least end up getting my prizes, but I was having fun playing. There’s a handful of games, not just claw machines. I quite like the coin pushers. It threw me off when I saw there were both real live coin pushers and also digital ones. Honestly, the digital ones are better. The real ones are typically are full of people and won’t let you play. They also have technical issues like the lights not working right or pieces falling off. Plus you can’t see the drop line to know how many coins actually fell and if they’re being counted correctly. The virtual ones are more accurate in the way of counting the coins, and there’s fewer players. The plinko mini game was fun for a few seconds. They don’t have a great payout though and the coins tend to fall in the same spot over and over no matter how you drop it. The crane games are great. Love the mechanic where the claw moves in short bursts. Other apps always frustrated me with how much of a delay there was, and this short burst control makes for more accurate placement. Yes, when you tap on a machine for a certain prize, the one you’re grabbing isn’t the same as advertised. However, that’s the norm in these apps. It records what prize you actually wanted and that’s what SHOULD show up once shipped. I cannot attest for how good shipping is. My prizes (as of yesterday) had not been mailed out yet.

title: Real Claw Machines! Real Prizes! Real Support!
body: I rarely take the time to leave reviews for apps, but Claw Eden genuinely deserves one. I’ve tried a lot of reward and game apps, but this is the first one that’s kept me coming back. Playing real claw machines and coin pushers through live cameras is so much more exciting than typical mobile games. What really impressed me is the customer service. Every time I’ve had a question or issue, they’ve responded within minutes and have been friendly and helpful. It’s obvious there’s a real team behind this app that truly cares about the player experience. I also love that you can have real prizes you win shipped to you or exchange them for coins or Amazon gift cards. One suggestion: I’d love to see an official referral program in the future. Rewarding players for recommending Claw Eden to friends and family would be a great way to grow the community while thanking loyal players.

title: Fun & Legit
body: The game is very fun. I love to play the claw machines. I’ve won about 20 prizes now. I just got my first package in the mail with 10 prizes from the claw machine and the prizes are good quality. The shipping was faster than I expected too. A little pricey for shipping but not bad at all. The claw machines are challenging but not impossible by any means. When I don’t have coins to play it’s still fun to watch other people play and win live. I also really love the livestream every day with our friendly host Doris. I definitely recommend this game to others, just be smart about your spending!

title: Fantastic Game
body: I love this game so much at first I was a little worry because I have been scam in the past with other games but this one is amazing I have played almost for a year now and I have win so many prizes including Sony angels and they are REAL!!! In conclusion I love it and I will play it for the rest of my life.

title: I really like it
body: I really like the variety of prizes…. shipping is super fast considering. Prices are fair. The win rate is decent. I think it is definitely better than other claw apps like Clawee. Oh and there service side things are great as well, very quick to respond to glitches and errors..

title: Awesome but
body: I love this claw machine app,has amazing prizes and great prices for coins. I love that it’s fast shipping as well. Though I recently tried logging in today and it said I violated their rules. From what I believe, I have not violated any rules. I paid a lot of money into this app and this has really upset me since I really enjoyed this claw game app. I’m hoping I can get some help , if I do then this will definitely be a 5 star review >~<

title: Updated review!! 10-19-22
body: I had won quite a bit of prizes, but I also spent like $50. However I was playing today and had about 10 or more prizes won that I haven’t shipped yet. The game won’t open at all now, and I’ve uninstalled the game and reinstalled and still having the same issue… I’m worried since I uninstalled it I lost all my prizes. I also still had like 20,000 coins and can’t get in the app at all… please help and I’ll update my review. Update!! Sooo my app eventually worked again. I just left it alone for a few days and tried one night and it loaded right up! I shipped all my prizes and just today, I recieved some of my prizes!!! I won one of the anime girl figures, along with some one piece figures and a keychain pop!! Firstly, I would like to say that this stuff shipped really fast, it was a few weeks. But I’m used to waiting for temu stuff lol. It was no longer than their shipping speed. I’m VERY impressed with the quality of the figures. They have a nice weight to them and are actually quite detailed!!! I cannot WAIT to get my other prizes. 10/10 I will say that the game does require a little bit of skill. The claws are weak but it’s not impossible to win, it’s all about skill.

title: Legit but still luck based
body: Theres plenty ways to win… i won one by bouncing a plush so gotta account for bounce ricochet too. Overall spent 20 or so and got maybe 7 prizes? Have noticed a lot of my complimentary tokens dont bode so well so, may be more lucky with money bought tokens? Not sure. Overall pretty dang pleased with the app and following through with sending those quintessential quintuplet figures etc. can see why mixed reviews, but can see a decent business being ran at the same time.

title: SO FAR, SO GOOD! 😃
body: I will admit at times the motion of the claws are a little bit glitchy,/laggy, but in my first day, I won five prizes already, Including an awesome Funko pop set of One Piece figures, two different Hunter X Hunter noodle stopper figures, a Sanrio Kuromi toy and a Pikachu… and a couple of my wins were on the very first shot, which was pretty awesome! On my second day, I won 5 prizes, including two Quintessential Quintuplets figures, a Rem from Re: Zero noodle stopper figure, a strawberry Hello Kitty plush and a cute Kuromi dressed as a purple panda plush. I think 10 prizes in my first day and a half is pretty decent ! Shipping is relatively cheap, like two dollars an item, and if you join a club (jade or ruby), you get shipping discounts by like a dollar per shipment. it’ll credit you like five dollars, which is dolled out with shipments at a dollar per request. There’s a lot of other fun games where you can get opportunities to win coins, plus daily rewards bonuses as well, and quite frankly, the price of paying for coins is pretty cheap as well. I Already submitted a couple shipping orders, so let’s wait and see how long it takes to get my prizes. Some of the reviews in the forum say that they received them pretty quick, like 15 days. They have a decent selection of prizes, and like any claw machine app or even live ones in an actual arcade , you do need some skill. They also do live streams, which are really cool, and if you recharge you can enter a lottery to win all kinds of really great anime figures and other stuff. So far so good! Really liking this app so far, as I am a huge claw machine buff! Now we just wait to see how long the shipping actually takes. If you’re not winning anything at this game, you really don’t have any skill with claw machines. UPDATE: decided to get a 1 month jade club membership and a recharge….in 4-1/2 days , I’ve won 31 awesome prizes, and some have already shipped… mostly anime figures. I really like this app! and they have a lot of prizes that only cost 60 coins to play, so your coins can go a long way
